program_solutions:
(rule!
  (paint-cells
    g
    (flatmap
      (lambda (obj)
        (let ((cells (obj-cells obj)))
          (if (and (= (obj-color obj) 1)
                   (any? (lambda (p) (= (fst p) 0)) cells)
                   (not (any?
                          (lambda (p)
                            (or (= (fst p) (- h 1))
                                (= (snd p) 0)
                                (= (snd p) (- w 1))))
                          cells)))
              cells
              (list))))
      (objects g 0))
    3))
